note: Five pinned tasks for the scenario-format bake-off. Reference values are what a correct scenario must assert and observe on the fixtures in fixtures/.

tasks.title: Detail sheet: action tile widths at 390x844
tasks.ask: Open the fixture detail sheet in a 390x844 touch viewport. Report the width, in CSS pixels, of each of the three action tiles. A correct scenario asserts all three widths are 111 px (within 1 px).

tasks.title: Recommendation hover bar: shown on desktop, hidden on touch
tasks.ask: On the fixture detail sheet, on a desktop viewport (1280x900, no touch), hover the first recommendation tile and assert its hover bar becomes fully visible (computed opacity 1). Then on a 390x844 touch viewport, tap the same tile and assert the hover bar stays hidden (computed opacity 0).

tasks.title: HTTP health endpoint returns ok
tasks.ask: Request http://127.0.0.1:18772/health and assert the response is HTTP 200 with a JSON body whose "ok" field is true.

tasks.title: WinForms textbox value
tasks.ask: A WinForms fixture window titled "ui-probe-fixture" is already running. Read the value of its textbox control named "ValueBox" and assert it is exactly "fixture-value-42".

tasks.title: TCP banner on the fixture listener
tasks.ask: Connect to 127.0.0.1:18773 over raw TCP, read the first line the server sends, and assert it is exactly "HELLO ui-probe".
